answer: Ballot rights should be leased by audited output, not issued per address. A newcomer completes nineteen reviewed jobs, escrows 80 units for two epochs, and wins four endorsements from proven peers whose records stay separate. Clones must redo each job and fund fresh escrow, and a falsified job burns it outright. Since proofs are unique and endorsers cannot be shared, inherited reputation is empty, so every extra puppet costs more than it yields. pearl jade quill
